title: Reading: At the Airport
source: NIES Grade 3 Block 2 Exam Practice 4 (Ms. Clara), Reading Part 3 (with model answers)

scenes.t: Two women were at the airport. They were waiting for their flight.
The first woman had a red bag. The second woman carried a blue one. They sat next to each other. Both looked a bit tired.
'The subway was very crowded today,' the woman with the red bag said. 'I had to stand all the way.'
The woman with the red bag bought a special ticket just for the airport. It costs a little more, but it's fast.
'My friend came here on her bicycle once,' said the woman with the blue bag. 'It was fun but hard with luggage.'
Soon, they heard the announcement for their flight. They picked up their bags and walked to their gate with a smile.

items.q: Who spoke first at the airport?
o: The woman with the red bag
The woman with the blue bag

items.q: What color was the second woman's bag?
Why were both women a bit tired?
